peak.historical_bridge: GCB annual relative movement scaled to BTR2021; official BTR 2005/2020/2021 retained; approximate scope bridge
peak.admitted_use: conditional_peak_bridge; not official historical peak certification

current_initial_state.subsidy_history: observed annual generation allocated to reconstructed cohorts; finite actual 2015-2024 fiscal budgets replayed; eligibility proxy, not project register
current_initial_state.support_2021: no wind/solar eligibility for reconstructed online cohorts from 2021; pre-2021 grandfathering proxy
current_initial_state.opening_finance: book-value debt ratio and gross-cost liquidity priors; residual explicitly owned shareholder equity
current_initial_state.queue: each lead-year receives 2021-2024 mean net stock addition times disclosed multiplier; costs funded in opening WIP plus restricted escrow
current_initial_state.construction: 2024 stock and 2021-2024 net additions seed capacity; solar manufacturing growth elapsed historical years reset to zero

coal.evidence: CEC 2024 gross commissioning proxy; solar rounded; not measured maximum throughput

gas.evidence: CEC 2024 gross commissioning proxy; solar rounded; not measured maximum throughput

hydro.evidence: CEC 2024 gross commissioning proxy; solar rounded; not measured maximum throughput

nuclear.evidence: CEC 2024 gross commissioning proxy; solar rounded; not measured maximum throughput

wind.evidence: CEC 2024 gross commissioning proxy; solar rounded; not measured maximum throughput

solar.evidence: CEC 2024 gross commissioning proxy; solar rounded; not measured maximum throughput

current_initial_state.other: thermal remainder plus Other stock inactive; Other generation split pump utilisation sensitivity and statistical adjustment
current_initial_state.thermal_subtypes: coal/gas rounded 2024 CEC anchors; oil fixed at 2014 5116MW; annual subtype shares interpolated, not observations
current_initial_state.asset_age: 2009 residual uniform ages plus positive stock increments to 2024, normalized to exact endpoint; not gross commissioning register

assumptions.starting_state: independent observed 2024 aggregate scale; explicit unobserved age/finance/queue reconstruction, not a historical-path stock correction
assumptions.observation_fit: opening match is an initial condition, never historical-fit validation
assumptions.tariffs: 2024 real energy-only tariff and auxiliary fractions held constant
assumptions.public_funding: 2024 real receipts and expenditure authority held constant times disclosed factor; no extra treasury cash
assumptions.support: existing rights, arrears and caps retained; 2024 biomass programme continued; no new wind/solar subsidy offers
assumptions.policy_scope: legacy-policy continuation counterfactual; post-2024 national CfD and capacity-revenue transition incomplete
assumptions.biological_service: existing bounded delivery scenario extended; no observed future waste series
assumptions.initial_statistics: training-fitted bridge dynamics with explicit independent 2024 observation anchor
assumptions.information: current fuel/availability condition persists for investment planning; recovery not known in advance
assumptions.weather: annual representative-day stress, not an observed meteorological event or seasonal reliability claim
assumptions.scope: mainland aggregate CO2, no all-GHG neutrality certification
